drivingQuestion: What does 'she has uttered her voice against me' refer to?

segments.he: ״הָיְתָה לִּי נַחֲלָתִי כְּאַרְיֵה בַיָּעַר נָתְנָה עָלַי בְּקוֹלָהּ עַל כֵּן שְׂנֵאתִיהָ״, מַאי ״נָתְנָה עָלַי בְּקוֹלָהּ״? אָמַר מָר זוּטְרָא בַּר טוֹבִיָּה אָמַר רַב, וְאָמְרִי לַהּ אָמַר רַבִּי חָמָא אָמַר רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר: זֶה שְׁלִיחַ צִבּוּר שֶׁאֵינוֹ הָגוּן הַיּוֹרֵד לִפְנֵי הַתֵּיבָה.
segments.en: The Gemara cites a verse in relation to the prayer leader: «“My heritage has become to me as a lion in the forest. She has uttered her voice against me; therefore I have hated her”» (Jeremiah 12:8). «What is» the meaning of the phrase: «“She has uttered her voice against me”? Mar Zutra bar Toviyya said» that «Rav said, and some say Rabbi Ḥama said» that «Rabbi Elazar said: This is an unworthy prayer leader who descends before the ark.» When this person calls out to God, He thinks, so to speak: I hate the sound of his prayer.
